notes.text: The sheet is dated “dec. 81–janv. 82”. This is a mathematical text sheet, not a cover. Its title concerns stratified spaces and conical neighbourhoods, with déploiement as the parenthetical reformulation. The diagram, legend and prose specify deployed strata, connecting tubes, connecting fibres and general flag-indexed boundary/fibration conditions. This reports the source; no theorem has been verified.

A source-level tension is preserved: the nonsingular b item calls Sigma_ik to Sigma_k a fibration, whereas the diagram gives that arrow a hook and labels the plain arrow from Sigma_ik to Sigma_i by (F_ik). The literal target k is clear and has not been regularised. The Sigma_ji (j<i) boundary expression in the a item is also retained as written.

The parenthetical F_ijk sentence has no visible closing parenthesis. Its fibro-/fibre-jonction term and the retraced en remain doubtful. In the final interval formula, a possible upper n cancellation and lower p+1 insertion are recorded within a single explicit uncertainty of reading and state; no definite chronology is claimed.

The lower-left 1 is transcribed as a margin element. Its pale narrow stroke does not establish that it is the author’s own pagination or that it was written with the dated main notes (“dec. 81–janv. 82”). H’s section heading Espaces et ensembles préordonnés ; pseudo-partitions is absent from the whole sheet and is excluded as editorial framing.
